purpose: Observe the placement and chaining of exactly zero, one, and two Jet 3 table-definition continuation pages using an established small-definition control and two bounded wide-definition targets.

preregistration.prior_evidence: EXP-0059 records the bounded 18-byte physical-column record, one-byte CP1252 column-name length and bytes, definition logical-length field, 2,048-byte root capacity, and 2,040-byte continuation contribution. That grammar predicts logical lengths 66, 2,075, and 4,105 for the three exact schemas. EXP-0061 records the bounded inline, single-page, and chained long-value framing used only to account for a created catalog LvProp value; EXP-0091 records null as a bounded consumable LvProp form. EXP-0065 records the global allocation map's free versus in-use classification and bounded reuse observations. EXP-0073 records the bounded catalog, page-role, usage-map, and continuation-chain decoder. EXP-0087 records the exact Alpha table with one dbLong Id field and a single definition root with no continuation page; EXP-0093 independently records empty first-create framing and page roles for a definition that fits one page. EXP-0095 records that the first attempt reached capture_zero in all replicas but its combined 64-page geometry check retained no created arm and identified no failed clause. EXP-0100 validates the bounded successor producer and capture contracts and diagnoses the 2,046-byte zero-control premise as false, but its all-or-no_outcome rule makes every continuation count, placement, pointer, counter, and other format observation from that run non-promotable. Therefore EXP-0100 supplies no evidence for the one- or two-continuation target expectations in this plan. EXP-0103 records another valid no_outcome whose three analyzers consistently diagnosed one appended page-role record as unassigned. That diagnostic is design input for preserving an explicit unassigned record only when the decoded global allocation map marks the page free, rather than requiring a semantic attribution; EXP-0103 promotes no page role, tag, owner, allocation status, continuation count, placement, pointer, counter, or other format fact. EXP-0059's separate wide-table endpoint referenced zero-based page index 172, implying a file of at least 173 pages; that is design input for retaining the 256-page completed-checkpoint bound, not evidence about these exact targets or their placement.
preregistration.authorization: This successor is SHA-256-pinned and forbids acquisition until the exact preregistration commit is merged. The user's 2026-09-02 instruction prospectively authorizes at most one three-replica run of this exact merged successor; any post-mutation failure consumes that authorization.
preregistration.attempt_policy: Dispatch at most one three-replica run after explicit authorization. Once the first DAO CreateDatabase mutation begins, any failure is a scientific result and must not be retried without another explicit human decision. A replica stops immediately after its first post-mutation failure.

execution.environment: The private local Windows development VM documented in docs/LOCAL_WINDOWS_VM.md, using x86 Windows PowerShell and a ready DAO.DBEngine.36 provider.
execution.independence: Each replica creates and closes one fresh dbVersion30 CP1252 database, retains it as empty, then copies and identity-checks it into three working arms before any TableDefs mutation. The zero arm receives exactly Alpha with one dbLong Id field. The one and two arms receive exactly the unchanged 70- and 140-field targets. Each arm is closed before metadata capture. No rows or indexes are added.

scenarios.zero: Alpha has exactly one dbLong field named Id. EXP-0059's grammar predicts its 66-byte logical definition, while EXP-0087 records the exact schema on one definition root with zero continuation pages, making it the established small-definition control.
scenarios.one: ContOneX has 70 dbLong fields with exact ten-byte ASCII names F000AAAAAA through F069AAAAAA. The recorded grammar predicts a 2,075-byte logical definition and one continuation contribution; the predicted count is a preregistered target, not an observation from EXP-0100.
scenarios.two: ContTwoX has 140 dbLong fields with exact ten-byte ASCII names F000AAAAAA through F139AAAAAA. The recorded grammar predicts a 4,105-byte logical definition, exceeding the root plus one 2,040-byte continuation contribution by 17 bytes and requiring a second continuation contribution; the predicted count is a preregistered target, not an observation from EXP-0100.

execution.capture: All ephemeral bases and arms live under one newly created, non-reparse working subdirectory with at most twelve fixed working MDB names. Root publication is nonrecursive, so a working-file cleanup failure remains a producer failure without contaminating the exact retained root MDB inventory; no working artifact is published or interpreted. Before any table append, copy all three working arms in zero, one, two order and record an exact ordered arm_baselines entry after each copy passes its size, SHA-256, and measurement identity check against the retained empty image. A copy_arms failure may retain only the successfully checked ordered baseline prefix; phases at or after append_zero require all three entries, including a later failure during capture_zero. Before enforcing checkpoint policy, record the exact raw byte length, whether that length is divisible by 2,048, the derived page count when divisible, and the first failed predicate in fixed order: minimum_page_length, page_alignment, checkpoint_bound_exceeded. A completed checkpoint must be a regular non-reparse file of one through 256 pages. A passing producer retains exactly twelve closed MDB checkpoints with the same measurements, sizes, and SHA-256 values before and after bounded read-only DAO TableDefs metadata access. Capture the exact DAO table and field inventory, mutation_started, the bounded producer phase, and at most the active checkpoint's recovery image after a failure. failure_measurement may be present only for create_database after mutation starts, capture_empty, copy_arms, or an append/capture phase; it is null before CreateDatabase and for a cleanup-only failure at complete. Once CreateDatabase has set mutation_started, the active empty checkpoint may be recovered during create_database or capture_empty; later active scenario checkpoints may be recovered during their append or capture phases. An aligned active image above the 256-page checkpoint bound may be salvaged only through 512 pages with its exact size, SHA-256, measurement, reason checkpoint_bound_exceeded, and interpreted=false. Other bounded post-mutation recovery is likewise marked interpreted=false. Recovery bytes receive no DAO metadata access, are not decoded, and cannot answer any question. A failure above the recovery bound records its exact measurement but retains no MDB. For each completed arm, preserve all appended pages that the bounded decoder labels LVAL and distinguish those referenced by the catalog LvProp from unreferenced decoded labels. Enumerate every appended page with its decoded role record, owners, raw page tag, and global-map free status. An explicit unassigned role is retained as an observation only when the global map marks that page free; absence of a page-role record or an in-use unassigned page remains a decode failure. Every catalog LvProp referenced appended LVAL page must be globally in use; an unreferenced decoder-labeled LVAL page may be globally free and remains reported without a current ownership or purpose inference. Every globally free page's role and owners describe only the bounded decoder's classification of retained bytes and do not establish a current owner, purpose, reuse history, or semantic role. Definition root and continuation pages must not be globally free.

questions.continuation_counts: Do the established 66-byte control and the predicted 2,075- and 4,105-byte targets decode to exactly zero, one, and two continuation pages, respectively?
questions.placement: For each arm, where do the definition root and continuation pages land relative to the empty boundary; how does each chain pointer order them; what logical interval and used byte count does each page carry; and what decoded role record, owners, raw tag, and global-map free status are present for every appended page, including any explicit globally free unassigned record? A globally free page's decoded labels are retained-byte observations only and receive no current owner, purpose, reuse history, or semantic meaning. No consecutive or relative page order is presumed.
questions.counters: What are the bounded page-0 counter values before and after each create, and how do their deltas correlate observationally with the appended page count and exactly resolved catalog object identifier without assigning an unrecorded semantic?
questions.producer_outcome: Did all three replicas complete every exact arm?
questions.replication: Do the complete decoded relative observations agree across all three replicas?

decision_rule.accepted: The plan and all executed inputs match their final SHA-256 pins; all three replicas complete the exact four-checkpoint inventory once; every arm begins byte-identical to its retained empty image; every completed measurement is internally consistent, identifies no failed predicate, and records at most 256 pages; DAO metadata matches the exact declared Alpha(Id), ContOneX, or ContTwoX schema; all retained bytes remain unchanged by metadata access; the definitions have exact logical lengths 66, 2,075, and 4,105 and decode completely with zero, one, and two continuation pages, respectively; no definition root or continuation page is globally free; every catalog LvProp referenced appended LVAL page is globally in use; every appended page has an explicit decoded page-role record whose role, owners, raw tag, and global-map free status are retained, while an explicit unassigned role is permitted only for a globally free page and an unreferenced decoder-labeled LVAL page may likewise remain globally free; every globally free page's decoded labels remain retained-byte observations without current semantic inference; the complete page-0 changed-offset set, counter, and exactly resolved catalog-root observations are present; and complete relative observations, including globally free unassigned and unreferenced LVAL records, agree across replicas. Counter/catalog correlation is observational and assigns no additional semantic predicate. A fully decoded nonconsecutive placement or replica-stable explicit globally free unassigned or unreferenced LVAL page is an answered result.
decision_rule.no_outcome: Any post-mutation producer failure—including minimum-length, alignment, completed-checkpoint-bound, or recovery-bound failure—changed metadata identity, schema disagreement, decode or chain failure, unexpected logical length or continuation count, globally free definition page, globally free catalog LvProp referenced appended LVAL page, missing appended-page role record, in-use unassigned appended page, incomplete later arm, or replica disagreement is recorded as no_outcome. A recovery-only image is never interpreted and cannot change that classification.
decision_rule.rejected: A pre-mutation plan, input, provider, or infrastructure failure; pin mismatch; malformed result or measurement; inconsistent mutation/phase/checkpoint/arm_baselines/recovery state; an arm_baselines entry that is out of order, exceeds three, differs from empty, or disagrees with its later checkpoint; unexpected, reordered, duplicate, missing, symlinked, or extra artifact; a completed checkpoint above 256 pages; a retained recovery above 512 pages; or analyzer contract defect rejects validation without a scientific outcome.
decision_rule.retry: There is no automatic retry after the first DAO mutation.

retention.publish: environment.json, result.json, the bounded job result, up to twelve exact expected-name MDBs including at most one explicitly identified, uninterpreted active-checkpoint recovery artifact per failed replica (exactly twelve completed checkpoints for a passing job), and the deterministic analyzer report. Completed checkpoints are at most 256 pages; recovery-only salvage is at most 512 pages.
retention.repository: Never commit MDB bytes or provider binaries. Record a validated report identity and conclusion once as a later additive EXP outcome.

publication.canonical_result: One validated deterministic JSON report and one later additive EXP outcome.

exclusions: definition chains longer than two continuation pages or tables above 140 columns
variable, Boolean, long-value, indexed, relationship, saved-query, or populated table definitions

general allocation policy, free-page reuse history, a presumption that continuation pages are consecutive, or any current owner, purpose, or semantic attribution inferred from a globally free page's decoded role or owners

catalog LvProp payload grammar, a presumption that its storage remains single-page, or a claim that every unreferenced decoder-labeled appended LVAL page is currently allocated; only its raw header/reference, global-map free status, and referenced versus unreferenced decoded inventory may be preserved
names other than exact Alpha, Id, ContOneX, ContTwoX, and F000AAAAAA through F139AAAAAA; locale or collation behavior
public creation API, initial rows, filesystem publication, writer correctness, hosted differential #102, compatibility claims, and support-matrix movement
